There are six legal destinations for a couch, and the right one depends on three questions: what condition it's in, how soon it needs to go, and whether you have a truck and a second person. Here they are, honestly compared.

## The Six Options

**1. Donation (free, condition-dependent).** Charities, furniture banks, and shelters take couches that pass inspection: no stains, odors, rips, moisture history, or pests. Many offer scheduled pickup. The best outcome for a usable couch, and the one to try first. [Here's the checklist charities apply](/blog/eco-friendly-living/can-couch-be-donated/).

**2. Resale or giveaway (free or cash, condition-dependent).** Marketplace listings move sound couches in days in most cities, and [a decent couch has real value](/blog/home-cleaning/how-much-is-a-used-couch-worth/). The buyer handles the carry and the truck.

**3. Municipal bulk pickup (free to modest fee, city-dependent).** Every city runs this differently, from NYC's no-appointment trash-day pickup to San Antonio's twice-a-year schedule to San Diego, which has no program at all. Our metro guides cover [New York](/blog/junk-removal/how-to-get-rid-of-a-couch-in-new-york-city/), [Los Angeles](/blog/junk-removal/how-to-get-rid-of-a-couch-in-los-angeles/), [Chicago](/blog/junk-removal/how-to-get-rid-of-a-couch-in-chicago/), [Houston](/blog/junk-removal/how-to-get-rid-of-a-couch-in-houston/), [Phoenix](/blog/junk-removal/how-to-get-rid-of-a-couch-in-phoenix/), and more. The universal rule: [know your city's set-out rules before the couch touches the curb](/blog/junk-removal/can-i-leave-a-couch-on-the-curb/).

**4. Transfer station or landfill (fee per load, your truck).** Accepts any condition. You need a vehicle, help loading, and often proof of residency. The cheapest route for an unusable couch if you already have the truck.

**5. Retailer haul-away (free to a fee, at delivery).** Many furniture retailers remove the old piece when delivering the new one. Convenient when timing aligns; usually restricted to one-for-one.

**6. Booked removal (from $90, any condition, your schedule).** Loaders carry it from inside your home, haul it, and route it: donation first where condition allows, recycling where facilities exist, disposal last. The only option built for "I need it gone this week and I don't have a truck." [Pricing by ZIP](/pricing/) and the full [cost comparison](/blog/junk-removal/how-much-does-couch-removal-cost/).

## Choosing in Ten Seconds

Good condition and time to spare: donate or sell. Good condition, no time: booked removal with donation routing. Poor condition, you have a truck: transfer station. Poor condition, no truck: booked removal. Any condition, curb rules unclear: do not use the curb until you've checked.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Where is the cheapest place to dispose of a couch?

Donation or a marketplace giveaway if it's usable, since both are free. For an unusable couch, your city's bulk pickup if offered, then a transfer station if you have a truck.

### Can I take a couch to the dump?

Yes, most transfer stations and landfills accept furniture for a per-load fee, often with proof of residency. You handle transport and loading.

### Will a furniture store take my old couch?

Many offer haul-away with delivery of a new piece, sometimes free, sometimes for a fee, usually one old item per new one. Ask before delivery day.

### How do I dispose of a couch quickly?

Booked removal: [same-day in most cities when booked before 2PM local time](/couch-removal/), carried from inside your home, no truck or second person required.
